name: Bohaiornis
sum: Bohaiornithid from the Jiufotang Formation of Liaoning with a broad snout and stomach stones.
holotype: LPM B001, a fully articulated subadult skeleton from the Jiufotang Formation.
material: The holotype and a larger referred specimen, IVPP V17963 (2014).
biology: A few large rough stones in the belly were first read as a sign of a mainly carnivorous diet; Liu et al. (2021) questioned whether they are gastroliths.
author: Hu et al. 2011
